mapper.sql: co.id, co.content, co.article_id, co.user_id, co.parent_id, co.status, co.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (content, article_id, user_id, parent_id, status) VALUES (#{content}, #{articleId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT , u.username, u.avatar FROM comment co LEFT JOIN `user` u ON co.user_id = u.id WHERE co.article_id = #{articleId} AND co.status = 1 ORDER BY co.created_at ASC
